newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 20.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* An amendment to legalize casino gambling before the New York State Legislature may still win passage despite appearing headed for a defeat last week.
* Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat arrives in Hebron and deliveres a message of conciliation in a speech before 60,000 people.
* President Clinton's challenges in the second term include redefining the Democratic Party and uniting its factions to prevent a Republican victory in 2000.

* Fewer than half the respondents in a New York Times/CBS New Poll expect progress toward issues such as balancing the budget and restraining entitlement costs, even while giving Clinton his highest performance rating in four years.
* Republican unity over ethics violations against Speaker Newt Gingrich shows signs of cracking.
* Slavery based on racial and religious differences endures in Africa.
* A nearly all-white small town in New Hampshire, the only one in the nation without a day remembering Martin Luther King Jr, gets Monday proclaimed in King's honor.
